card.name: Porro
card.tagline: Caribbean brass-band dance music of the savannas.
card.profile: A festive couples dance-music of Colombia's Caribbean savannas (Cordoba, Sucre, Bolivar), in 2/2 'compas partido,' derived from traditional gaita ensembles meeting European-style wind/military bands (Wikipedia ES; ColombiaOne). Two folk types: porro palitiao (Sinu River/San Pelayo) and porro tapao/sabanero (El Carmen de Bolivar). Played by 'pelayera' brass bands; popularized in orchestral form by Lucho Bermudez and Pacho Galan.
card.insight: Ley 2259 de 2022 (19 July 2022), Art. 1: 'Reconozcase al Porro como manifestacion del Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial y el Festival del Porro de San Pelayo como una accion de salvaguardia' (SUIN-Juriscol).
card.image_significance: The savanna brass-band dance. A representative image shows colorful regional costume and lively partner or troupe footwork — Cordoba/Sucre, Colombia.
